canonical_semantic_rereview.reason: OpenClaw is explicitly queued for current-contract re-review of its legacy S2=C witness. This capability review records the current canonical state but does not settle that semantic review.

canonical_s2_mechanism: The current canonical assessment credits authorized cross-session messaging plus session ownership/lifecycle controls as a constructor path for operational coordination; no stock autonomous anti-oscillation policy is closed out of the box.

upstream_disturbance_issue.title: scope: "shared" sandboxes collapse all agents onto one workspace; no per-agent persona isolation
upstream_disturbance_issue.reported_disturbance: Multiple distinct agents using a shared sandbox can converge on one writable workspace mount, allowing a later agent to read or modify another agent's persona, memory or skills files.

current_upstream_source_check.interpretation: Current source still supports the structural disturbance path described by issue #113166. This is disturbance evidence only; it does not demonstrate attenuation through a native S2 treatment.

comparability_note: The disturbance is in the same broad workspace/interference family as the existing thClaws canonical direct anchor, but OpenClaw currently contributes only a source-reproducible disturbance case. Without an exercised native attenuation treatment and outcome, it is not a second comparable canonical direct row.
reopen_when: Public upstream evidence publishes a recoverable native or adapter-preserved treatment/result for distinct OpenClaw agents/workspaces that exercises the reported interference condition and demonstrates attenuation, with enough provenance to classify a direct observation and materially compare it with an existing canonical S2 workspace-interference row where appropriate. Any such transaction must also reconcile the then-current canonical S2 state after issue #263 or its successor semantic review.
do_not_reopen_for: the source-reproducible disturbance report by itself
a fix commit without a recoverable exercised disturbance-to-attenuation result
generic sandbox isolation or mount tests that do not instantiate competing S1 agents and measure the affected outcome
issue closure without public result artifacts supporting attenuation
an Opensiro-operated OpenClaw benchmark or reproduction
non_claim: This review does not score OpenClaw S2 capability, validate the current S2=C assessment under the latest methodology, admit an observation, add a benchmark family, or reopen the matched-canonical primary search. It records a strong public disturbance surface and the specific missing attenuation evidence.
